frozen: 2026-11-15, before any M6 run. Any change requires a new config_version reported alongside this one.
scope: RECORDED-NON-ASTRONAUT methods demonstration. Not astronaut data, not clinical, not validated.

windows.starts: range(0, n_samples - window + 1, step), per record; windows never cross a record
windows.time_base: uniform 256 Hz sample index (wrist timestamp channel not used)

reference.source: annotation code 1 (hand-marked chest-ECG R peaks) from the .atr file; the ECG waveform is never loaded
reference.definition: 60 / median RR of beats with start <= sample < start + window (identical to M5 dsp_hr)

ppg_preprocessing: physical units (raw - baseline) / gain; Butterworth band-pass order 3, 0.5-4.0 Hz, sosfiltfilt over the whole record (identical to M5 dsp_hr)

spectrum.segment_normalisation: per-window: subtract mean, divide by SD (if SD > 0)

ppg_features.features: 14 relative band powers (power in bin / power in band) + dominant frequency in band (Hz) = 15

accel_features.signal: magnitude sqrt(x^2 + y^2 + z^2) of the low-noise accelerometer, per window
accel_features.features: 19 relative band powers of the magnitude + dominant frequency (Hz) + 3 pairwise Pearson correlations (xy, xz, yz) + 3 log SD shares log(sd_axis / sqrt(sum sd^2)) = 26
accel_features.zero_variance_rules: correlation -> 0; SD share -> log(1/sqrt(3)); flat spectrum -> uniform relative powers and band-midpoint dominant frequency (counted as degenerate)

standardisation: z-score fitted on training-participant rows only, per fold; zero SD replaced by 1

A1.note: exact M5 peak-interval method; may decline windows

A2.definition: 60 x dominant frequency of the band-passed PPG spectrum in 0.5-4.0 Hz

A5.role: ablation: HR predictable from motion alone

ridge: closed form on standardised features; intercept = training mean of y, unpenalised

logistic.optimizer: scipy.optimize.minimize L-BFGS-B, analytic gradient, zero initialisation

record_level_vote: majority of window predictions; ties broken by label-set order
folds: leave-one-participant-out over sorted participant IDs; no random splitting at any level
hyperparameters: fixed (protocol option 1); no tuning, no inner loop

bootstrap.paired: the same resample indices are used for every model and every difference

rounding: predictions and references rounded to 6 decimals before scoring; the CSV values are exactly what is scored

S1.reason: The PhysioNet project page states each subject was 'starting from rest' but gives no onset time or rest duration; the dataset paper page (MDPI) could not be retrieved (HTTP 403). A cut-off would be invented, so per the approved decision S1 is omitted.

S2.scope: Task A re-run with screened windows removed from both training and test

failure_analysis.descriptors: activity mix, median reference HR, median accelerometer magnitude (header units, uncalibrated, descriptive only)
